mapper.insert: insert into booking (service_item_id, order_id, user_id, skiller_id, expect_time, remark, status, create_time, update_time) values (#{serviceItemId}, #{orderId}, #{userId}, #{skillerId}, #{expectTime}, #{remark}, #{status}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.sql: b.id, b.service_item_id as serviceItemId, b.order_id as orderId, b.user_id as userId, b.skiller_id as skillerId, b.expect_time as expectTime, b.remark, b.status, b.create_time as createTime, b.update_time as updateTime, si.title as serviceTitle, si.price as servicePrice, u.name as userName, sk.name as skillerName
mapper.select: select from booking b left join service_item si on b.service_item_id = si.id left join user u on b.user_id = u.id left join skiller sk on b.skiller_id = sk.id where b.user_id = #{userId} order by b.create_time desc
